title: Personal Assistant for Recovery Therapy and Next-Generation Engagement in Robotics
summary: The study looks at how robots can help patients in hospitals. The robots should fit well into the daily routine of the hospital and encourage patients to remain active. It is being tested whether the ideas with the robots work well in the hospital, how the patients react to the robots and which types of cooperation are best. It is important that the robots can talk to the patients. This enables them to better understand how the patients are feeling and to adapt their behavior. In addition, playful elements and rewards should help to motivate the patients.
conditions: The use of robotic assistance to motivate patients

interventions.name:
